name: io.github.Startlyst/agentic-commerce-architecture
title: Startlyst Agentic Commerce MCP
description: Self-sovereign BYOC headless commerce & agentic MCP checkout engine for B2B storefronts.

startlyst-agentic-commerce.description: Startlyst BYOC Headless Commerce, Licensing Catalog & Enterprise Procurement MCP Server

tools.name: get_storefront_catalog
tools.title: Get Startlyst Licensing Catalog
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only static snapshot of Startlyst's 8-SKU B2B BYOC catalog (USD pricing, billing cycles, payment rails, entitlements) bundled with the server build. Use to list all SKUs or compare cycles; use get_procurement_checkout_path for one SKU's checkout URLs and indicative FX rates, or evaluate_architecture_fit for tier sizing.

billingCycle.description: Filter returned SKUs by billing cycle. Passing "all" (default) returns all 8 monthly and annual SKUs; "monthly" or "annual" returns only the 4 matching SKUs.

skus.description: Filtered SKU catalog records with USD pricing and tier entitlements.

tools.name: evaluate_b2b_procurement_tco
tools.title: Evaluate Simple Annual B2B TCO
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only deterministic calculation comparing one Startlyst annual license against an illustrative 2% annual GMV fee using bundled static USD pricing (excludes buyer cloud hosting costs). Use for a quick single-tier annual check; use evaluate_architecture_fit for tier sizing, monthly x12 math, multi-store base costs, or regional tax.

annualGmvUsd.description: Projected annual Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) in USD used to compute an illustrative 2% legacy variable fee comparison. Values below 10000 are clamped to 10000; defaults to 5000000.

tier.description: Internal tier code mapped to its annual SKU: "single" maps to startup_annual, "growth" maps to growth_annual (default), "agency" maps to enterprise_annual, and "holding" maps to holding_annual.

illustrativeLegacyVariableFeeUsd.description: Illustrative 2% annual variable GMV fee in USD.

estimated12MonthNetSavingsUsd.description: Illustrative 12-month delta (legacy 2% fee minus annual license; excludes cloud hosting).

tools.name: get_omni_device_adapter_spec
tools.title: Get Omni-Device CSS & Headless Adapter Spec
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only static snapshot of Startlyst's 5 viewport profiles, CSS isolation contract (.stlyst-isolated-scope, --stlyst-*), and headless React/API mount points bundled with the server build. Use for frontend breakpoints and CSS/hook integration; use get_ai_customization_blueprint for repository boundaries, CLI setup, and UI redesign.

annotations.title: Get Omni-Device CSS & Headless Adapter Spec

targetDevice.description: Viewport profile filter. Passing "all" (default) returns all 5 viewport profiles; passing a specific device ID returns only the matching viewport specification.

ipProtectionLayers.description: Optional open workspace vs. sealed core layers.

tools.name: verify_legal_and_security_posture
tools.title: Verify Legal & Security Governance Posture
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only static snapshot of key Startlyst MSA clauses (Section 10 security updates, Section 11 unlawful-use indemnification, fail-closed /api/compile-zip Stripe gate) and the $100 USD liability cap bundled with the build. Use for legal/gating checks; use get_verified_benchmarks for metrics or get_procurement_checkout_path for tax/URLs.

section.description: Governance posture filter. Passing "all" (default) returns all 3 sections (agile-amendments, illegal-use-indemnification, stripe-artifact-gate); passing a specific section key returns only that entry inside posture.

posture.description: Filtered MSA/security clauses keyed by section ID.

tools.name: evaluate_architecture_fit
tools.title: Evaluate Architecture Fit & Regional TCO
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only deterministic sizing evaluation using bundled static rules (no live lookups) to select a tier/SKU from region, GMV, store count, RLS, OIDC, Redis, and billing cycle. Returns rationale, assumption-based TCO (monthly x12 or annual), and regional tax/cloud guidance. Use first for sizing; use get_procurement_checkout_path for a chosen SKU.

region.description: Primary buyer jurisdiction for Stripe Tax, tax ID, payment rail, and BYOC cloud-region guidance (defaults to "GLOBAL").

annualGmvUsd.description: Projected annual Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) in USD (>= 0, defaults to 5000000) used for tier sizing thresholds and assumption-based TCO calculation.

storeCount.description: Number of storefronts or brands to deploy (integer 1-1000, defaults to 1). Counts above 1, 3, and 12 escalate tier selection and scale illustrative legacy base-stack costs.

needsPostgresRls.description: Set to true if PostgreSQL primary/read-replica routing and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY are required (selects Enterprise tier or higher; defaults to false).

needsOidcSso.description: Set to true if Web Crypto OIDC JWT/JWKS SSO and live /api/admin/audit chain verification are required (selects Enterprise tier or higher; defaults to false).

needsMultiSubsidiaryGovernance.description: Set to true if multi-subsidiary tenant governance (/api/admin/tenants and holding-portfolio-governance.json) is required (selects Holding tier; defaults to false).

needsDistributedRedis.description: Set to true if distributed Redis/Upstash REST sliding-window rate limiting and 4-role RBAC are required (selects Growth tier or higher; defaults to false).

billingCyclePreference.description: Preferred billing cycle for SKU recommendation and TCO math: "annual" (default, uses annual prepay rate) or "monthly" (annualizes monthly rate x12 and reports annual-switch savings).

recommendation.description: Selected tier, SKU, file count, live USD price, FX equivalents, and rationale.

verifiedTechnicalEvidence.description: Measured build, load, memory, and SQLite WAL benchmarks.

transparentTcoEstimate.description: Assumption-based 12-month TCO (monthly x12 or annual) and annual-switch savings.

regionalTaxPaymentAndResidencyGuidance.description: Regional Stripe Tax regime, tax ID, rails, and BYOC cloud regions.

aiNativeOwnershipHighlights.description: Self-service, $0 UI redesign fee, and AI_AGENT_HANDOFF.md flags.

honestArchitecturalBoundaries.description: Fit scope, non-fit exclusions, and shared-responsibility notice.

nextSelfServiceActions.description: Self-service checkout, CFO brief API, catalog, and benchmark URLs.

tools.name: get_ai_customization_blueprint
tools.title: Get AI Customization & Handoff Blueprint
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only static tier-parameterized blueprint from the build covering AI_AGENT_HANDOFF.md, writable buyer vs. protected core paths, 6-step Day-1 CLI setup, startlyst:doctor diagnostics, and Ed25519/--upgrade-from-zip rules. Use for repository layout and safe UI redesign; use get_omni_device_adapter_spec for CSS scoping and viewports.

tier.description: Target Startlyst tier (startup, growth, enterprise, or holding; defaults to "growth") used to populate deliverable file counts and tier-specific managed kernel paths.

adapterMode.description: Target storefront mount mode (standalone, subpath, or headless; defaults to "standalone") echoed in the returned customization blueprint.

deliverableFileCounts.description: Monthly and annual ZIP file counts.

operatingModel.description: Zero-support flags and $0 UI redesign fee.

handoffArtifactsIncludedInEveryZip.description: Bundled handoff docs, typed bridge, and ignore guards.

threeStepPrePurchaseFlow.description: 3-step unzip, Day-1 build, and UI redesign sequence.

day1SixStepLaunchSequence.description: 6 Day-1 CLI commands and expected outcomes.

layerBoundaries.description: Writable buyer paths vs. protected kernel paths.

selfDiagnosticsAndAutonomousRepair.description: startlyst:doctor CLI commands, probes, and static_frozen_mode continuity.

tools.name: get_verified_benchmarks
tools.title: Get Verified Engineering Benchmarks
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only static snapshot of air-gapped local benchmarks for the current build (build footprint, 60s mixed load, 512 MB memory, 310k-row SQLite WAL, host-cutout autonomy, upgrades, 5 operational boundaries; no live tests run). Use to audit measured metrics; use evaluate_architecture_fit for sizing or verify_legal_and_security_posture for MSA terms.

category.description: Benchmark section filter. Passing "all" (default) returns all 6 sections (build, load, database, autonomy, upgrades, boundaries); passing a specific category returns only that key inside benchmarks.

reproductionConditions.description: Target artifact, runtime versions, isolation guard, and BENCHMARKS.md URL.

benchmarks.description: All 6 benchmark sections when category="all", or the single requested key.

tools.name: get_procurement_checkout_path
tools.title: Get SKU Pricing & Self-Service Checkout Path
tools.description: Unauthenticated, read-only lookup from bundled static tables returning live USD Stripe pricing vs. indicative EUR/GBP/CHF FX rates, file count, regional tax guidance, CFO brief API URLs, and self-service checkout links for one SKU (no session/charge created). Use once an SKU is chosen; use get_storefront_catalog to browse all or evaluate_architecture_fit to size.

annotations.title: Get SKU Pricing & Self-Service Checkout Path

sku.description: Exact Startlyst SKU identifier to resolve pricing, deliverable file count, renewal document URL, and self-service checkout path for (defaults to "growth_annual").

region.description: Buyer jurisdiction (US, EU, UK, CH, AU, or GLOBAL; defaults to "GLOBAL") used to attach regional Stripe Tax, tax ID, payment rail, and BYOC cloud-region guidance.

brandName.description: Optional company or storefront brand name (up to 80 characters, sanitized of angle brackets and quotes) appended as the brand query parameter in the returned CFO Executive Brief API URLs.

pricingMasterSsot.description: Live USD Stripe pricing, indicative EUR/GBP/CHF FX equivalents, and tax code.

procurementAndCheckoutUrls.description: Self-service checkout, CFO Executive Brief API, catalog, and renewal URLs.

regionalTaxAndPaymentGuidance.description: Regional Stripe Tax regime, tax ID, payment rails, and BYOC cloud regions.

operatingModelAndLegalSummary.description: Zero-touch flags, clickwrap requirement, 72h refund window, and shared responsibility.

resources.name: Startlyst Complete Long-Context Architecture, Pricing & Protocol Specification
